query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Razorpay on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Razorpay

**Meeting:** 17 November 2026
**Window reviewed:** roughly 30 days to 14 November 2026. All facts below come from the search results provided.

## Summary

Razorpay has cleared the main regulatory step for an IPO. The most recent news is about the listing, with one GIFT City licence as the other notable item. I found no sourced facts on hires or deals beyond IPO advisers.

## What changed

**IPO approval**
- India's market regulator SEBI approved Razorpay's IPO, according to a document shown on Friday, 13 November 2026. The company had confidentially filed draft papers in June for an IPO of about $600 million, per Reuters. (https://www.thehindu.com/business/indian-fintech-firm-razorpay-gets-regulatory-nod-for-ipo/article71698143.ece)
- SEBI issued its final observations on Razorpay's draft offer documents on 3 November. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Razorpay's shareholders approved a fresh share issue worth ₹2,700 crore, plus an offer for sale (OFS) in which existing investors can sell part of their holdings. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Axis Capital, JPMorgan, Citi and Kotak Mahindra Capital are advising on the offering. (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
- Inc42 reported the SEBI nod on 4 November for an IPO it sized at ₹6,000 crore. The source was only a headline and summary, so the figure is unverified. (https://inc42.com/buzz/razorpay-gets-sebi-nod-for-%E2%82%B96000-cr-ipo)
- Earlier coverage put the expected raise at ₹5,000–6,000 crore, through a fresh issue plus OFS, with price band and structure to follow in the red herring prospectus (RHP). (https://upstox.com/news/market-news/ipo/upcoming-ip-os-mahanadi-coalfields-oyo-cult-fit-carlsberg-india-are-among-big-ticket-ip-os-expected-after-jio-platforms-listing/article-202719)

**Launch**
- Razorpay received a final licence to expand cross-border payments from GIFT City. This is a headline on a Business Standard page dated 9 November, and I did not see the article body. (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)

**Hires and headcount**
- A company profile lists headcount at 4,033, down 16 year-on-year and 23 quarter-on-quarter, with 2 added in the last month. The page is undated, so it may fall outside the 30-day window. (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)

**Deals**
- No sourced deals found beyond IPO advisers and the GIFT City licence.

## Source gaps and conflicts

- **Issue size:** Sources give $600 million (The Hindu), ₹5,000–6,000 crore (Upstox), ₹6,000 crore (Inc42), and ₹2,700 crore fresh issue plus OFS (ET). These are not reconciled. The RHP should settle the figure.
- **Approval date:** ET says SEBI's observations were dated 3 November, while The Hindu reports the approval document was shown on 13 November.
- **Unusable result:** A market-movers article from HDFC Sky did not mention Razorpay in the excerpt, so I excluded it.

## Open questions

1. Once SEBI has approved the IPO, when will the RHP be filed, and how will the final size split between the ₹2,700 crore fresh issue and the OFS? (https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/technology/razorpay-moves-closer-to-public-market-debut-as-sebi-gives-green-signal-to-ipo/articleshow/135809192.cms)
2. What does the GIFT City cross-border licence allow, and when will the expanded service go live? (https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/ifsca-proposes-model-portfolios-in-gift-city-by-research-entities-126110900766_1.html)
3. With headcount reported down year-on-year, what are the hiring plans for the next 12 months, and will the IPO proceeds fund any of them? (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/aJrBNen1btW7)
